subject: Sarah Bradley Fulton Statue and Historical Commemorations
overview: The board of Looking Back at Medford History, Inc. met to discuss its mission to educate the public on local heritage and provided updates on the Sarah Bradley Fulton statue project. The meeting detailed plans for upcoming Patriot's Day activities and the annual Sarah Bradley Fulton Day event in October.

items.title: Organization Introduction and Board Introductions
items.summary: Host Laura Duggan introduced the board members of Looking Back at Medford History, Inc. and defined the group as a local 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

items.title: Nonprofit Origin and Mission Statement
items.summary: The board reviewed the organization's founding on June 6, 2020, and its mission to educate citizens on Medford's historical heritage through citywide events and monuments.

items.title: Patriot's Day Event Planning
items.summary: Board members detailed plans for a ceremony at Salem Street Burial Ground on April 21 followed by colonial activities and a Paul Revere reenactment at the Isaac Hall House.

items.title: Sarah Bradley Fulton Statue Fundraiser
items.summary: The board announced a May 21 fundraiser at the Medford Library featuring speaker Anthony Sammarco to support the installation of a bronze statue of Sarah Bradley Fulton at City Hall.

items.title: Sculpture Progress and Artifact Exhibits
items.summary: The board reviewed photos of the life-sized clay model created by sculptor Robert Shore and discussed the previous exhibition of Fulton's historical artifacts loaned by the Royall House.

items.title: Sarah Bradley Fulton Day Preview
items.summary: Planning continued for the October 18 event, which will include a George Washington reenactor, fife and drum performances, and a theatrical production in the cemetery.

items.title: Board Goals and Historical Reenactment
items.summary: Board members shared their long-term vision for historical education in Medford before concluding with a short theatrical segment portraying Captain Isaac Hall and his wife.
